primary_metric.name: median-of-3 tc vs records (scale); confirmed records

attempts.hypothesis: multilevel V-cycle: coarse solve + cold uncoarsen refinement beats flat SA at scale
attempts.causal_note: CONFIRMED RECORD ksg 37.761 (ref 39.116). Attribution inverted: coarse level is a perturbation; descent = span-gated COLD refinement ratchet; matching coarsener seeds worse than greedy (drop it)

attempts.hypothesis: racing portfolio (successive halving + slope) converts scale variance into expected gain
attempts.causal_note: No record by 0.009 (surfacecode worse-of-two 48.718 vs bar 48.709; both medians beat the reference). Probe leader never won 4/4; slope save decisive once; beats single-anneal control by 22 log2

attempts.hypothesis: structural sweep seed + cold refine + window repair beats records on layered instances
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED geometrically: any 1-D sweep comb is lower-bounded by boundary width 71-126 >> achievable 39-61; STRUCT-SKIP fired 4/4; window repair re-confirmed inert on peaked incumbents (033 certificate reproduced)

attempts.hypothesis: BFS-separator nested dissection with Staudt injection beats records on planar-ish instances
attempts.causal_note: Injection mechanism works (boundary accumulation 83->61.6, max node 83->37) but separator seeds still lose to greedy portfolio; direction closed

attempts.hypothesis: hyperedge VE-seeding beats records on shared-label instances
attempts.causal_note: CONFIRMED RECORD dbn_13 29.000 + TTF RECORD 0.2s (VE seed is instant record-quality; 16 log2 over greedy). Same mechanism refuted at 4086 labels (nqueens): VE too slow and lower-quality

attempts.hypothesis: real-provenance instances carry fusible structure the proxy lacked; simplify-then-anneal wins at matched budget
attempts.causal_note: TWO CONFIRMED RECORDS: sycamore_53_20_0 60.169 (ref 60.605), surfacecode_d21 47.824 (ref 48.759). 88.7% shrink on the real circuit; reference wastes budget annealing raw structure

attempts.hypothesis: mass randomized greedy + bandit tuning dominates SA at n~5000 by paths-per-second
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED: quality ceiling 15-208 log2 above records regardless of trials; 1.2 builds/s not hundreds; SA dominates

attempts.hypothesis: spectral recursive bisection finds global cut structure faster than local search
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED decisively (+108 to +153): power iteration cannot converge (gap O(1/n^2)); even perfect bisection geometrically dominated by non-bisection SA trees

attempts.hypothesis: congestion-softmax boost passes accelerate 032's warm SA at scale
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED by A/B: softmax collapses onto the dominant node on peaky profiles, 40-80% dead traversal, strictly worse on 3/4; helps only flat-profile lattices

attempts.hypothesis: cache-blocked regional SA raises moves/s >=3x at n>=3000
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED both axes: pointer trees have no memory contiguity to exploit (0.54-1.34x); blocking starves global moves (isolation control confirms)

attempts.hypothesis: boundary-MPS combs on detected 2D geometry beat records on lattice instances
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED: instances are non-planar with cutwidth 90-120 (5 layout heuristics verified); comb floor far above balanced-tree records; also exposed GreedyMethod tie-break cascade bug (~82s, 1-in-5 at n~5000)

attempts.hypothesis: annealing vertex-elimination orders explores a different landscape than tree rewrites
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED strongly despite successful O(window) incremental engineering: order landscape is flat (30 improvements / 2.5M cold moves); representation floor ~2x above tree space; all descent came from the tree-space polish

attempts.hypothesis: elite trees occupy complementary basins; non-destructive path-relinking recombines them
attempts.causal_note: Mechanism CONFIRMED (20 recombinant wins over better parent; monotone 70-log2 descent over 12 relinks) but pool diversity collapses after ~12 relinks; no record. Lever: diversity maintenance

reflection.review: 13-attempt scale batch on the expanded instance set. FOUR CONFIRMED TC RECORDS + one TTF record, the project's first algorithm-level wins: 039 simplify-then-anneal (real Sycamore 60.169, surfacecode 47.824), 034 span-gated cold V-cycle (ksg 37.761), 038 hyperedge VE-seed (dbn_13 29.000 @ TTF 0.2s). 035 racing missed by 0.009 with its mechanism confirmed. Seven falsifications with root causes; 032/033 measured non-competitive at scale. Attempts now hold 4/10 board records.
reflection.evidence:
- Records confirmed via median-of-3 + confirmation, worse-of-two, quiet machine, per-run relabeling.
- Mechanism pattern: wins come from exploiting structure OUTSIDE tree-rewrite space (preprocessing, seed representation, budget allocation); all in-space construction variants lost to greedy+anneal.
- Library findings for the omeco PR: missing simplification front-end; GreedyMethod tie-break cascade at n~5000.
- Protocol economy: falsified attempts not validator-scored (scorer-verified locally, no claims); deviation noted.
reflection.lessons: Tuned TreeSA is the descent engine, not the bottleneck: feed it (simplify, structured seeds) and schedule it (span-gating, racing) rather than replace it. Pure-construction seeds fail identically across 5 variants (proxy floors above rewrite-space reach). Concurrency-distorted local numbers are for attribution only; the lanes+medians harness recovers clean signals.
reflection.literature: Simplification matches gray_2020_hyper's simplify cycle; the quantified matched-budget dominance vs tuned SA (0.44-0.94 log2) and the instant-VE-record TTF framing appear new. Span-gated refinement and racing-over-anneals not in the KB.
reflection.next: Cycle 9 (final round): 047 composite (route -> simplify -> seed -> span-gated refine -> racing), 052 span-gated deepening, 053 hierarchical VE; innovation wing: 048 replica exchange, 049 consensus-backbone freezing, 050 MCTS on simplified graphs, 051 late-acceptance hill climbing.
